en.t: In a couple of days, let's buy a small bonsai...

units.source_text: 连他自己也发愣了，可是，为了不再加重女人张皇失措的表情，

en.t: Even he himself was taken aback, but so as not to make the woman's panic-stricken expression grow any worse,

units.source_text: “怎么啦，连气都透不过来，煞风景，真是没办法……”

en.t: What's the matter? I can hardly breathe. It spoils the mood. There is really nothing to be done...
